title: Когда that можно не повторять
description: Когда that можно не повторять: применяем правило в новых ситуациях, разбираем словарь, диалог и авторский текст без аудирования.
objectives: Распознавать определяющую часть с пропущенным объектным местоимением
Не убирать местоимение, выполняющее роль подлежащего
notes: The book that I borrowed → The book I borrowed: I уже является подлежащим части.
В the person who called местоимение who само является подлежащим; просто убрать его нельзя.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: Which version can omit the relative pronoun?

options.label: The bus that stops here is late.
The book that I borrowed is here.
The person who called is here.

exercises.editorial_answer: The book that I borrowed is here.
exercises.explanation: В первом варианте that — объект при подлежащем I; в остальных местоимение — подлежащее.

exercises.prompt: Вставь слово из пары: who / that.

public_payload.sentence: The film ___ we watched was short.

exercises.editorial_answer: The film that we watched was short.
exercises.explanation: Фильм — предмет; that здесь можно также опустить, но who не подходит.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Книга, которую я взял, лежит на столе.»
exercises.editorial_answer: The book I borrowed is on the desk.
exercises.explanation: Пропущенное that является объектом borrowed, при этом I остаётся подлежащим.

exercises.prompt: Исправь ошибку в указанной конструкции, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: The person called me yesterday is waiting outside.

accepted: The person who called me yesterday is waiting outside.

exercises.reference_answer: The person who called me yesterday is waiting outside.
exercises.incorrect_answer: The person called me yesterday is waiting outside.
exercises.editorial_answer: The person who called me yesterday is waiting outside.
exercises.explanation: Нужно восстановить подлежащее who в определяющей части.

public_payload.passage: At the club, Nina showed us a guide she had borrowed from the library. The person who recommended it was waiting nearby. We compared the route the guide described with a newer map. One footpath was missing from the map, so we decided to ask the visitor centre before using it. Omitting a relative object made some phrases shorter, but it did not remove the need to check the route itself.

exercises.explanation: Who recommended it относится к человеку поблизости.

exercises.prompt: Соедини слова с переводом в контексте урока.
exercises.editorial_answer: borrow — брать взаймы; lend — давать взаймы; subject — подлежащее; object — дополнение
exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: borrow — брать взаймы; lend — давать взаймы; subject — подлежащее; object — дополнение.

public_payload.passage: At the club, Nina showed us a guide she had borrowed from the library. The person who recommended it was waiting nearby. We compared the route the guide described with a newer map. One footpath was missing from the map, so we decided to ask the visitor centre before using it. Omitting a relative object made some phrases shorter, but it did not remove the need to check the route itself.

options.label: The guide had no routes in it.
One footpath was absent from the newer map.

exercises.editorial_answer: One footpath was absent from the newer map.

lines.speaker: Собеседник
lines.text: Can I say “the letter I received” instead of “the letter that I received”?

options.label: Yes; the omitted pronoun is the object of received.
No; I cannot be a subject.
Yes; every relative subject can always be omitted.

exercises.editorial_answer: Yes; the omitted pronoun is the object of received.
exercises.explanation: I — подлежащее, поэтому объектное that можно опустить.
